scope: Actual final local workbench in dedicated cloud Chrome via CUA; official sites-preview, not public deployment or user local computer.

checks.observation: 页面显示 4763 原片帧、15 个语义 S、2183 张 PNG，306 工作项 = 302 线稿/局部改线 + 4 仅校色。
输入 4762 并回车，显示 PTS 2542800、时长 533、下一帧禁用；上一帧显示 4761 / PTS 2542272 / 时长 528。
F1908 深色对照模式分别显示精确源帧与透明叠加；恢复白卡 76451 个非透明像素，黑墨在独立 FX 轨。
M15 深/浅底与 FX 开关恢复；F504 棋盘格可见透明眼孔与粉色幽灵，右侧源图独立；F4182 浅底软花瓣没有带入手套墨线。
S06 跳转 F834 / local 0；M24 跳转 F3373 / local 979，仍属 S06；段表显示 144 = 140 线稿 + 4 校色、49 已审对、0 条件对、91 次曝光 / 80 种复用稿。
不存在的 ID 搜索显示 0/0；清空并选别名显示 36/54；重置可恢复任务列表。
ART-G12-10 标为仅校色、不另画线稿，提供工作范围及证据；F840 指向 canonical ART-G33-01，不重复计入 G12。
F3368 自动 FX 在字幕上；手动移到下方后明确显示覆盖状态且保留原关系；F4182 混合层序显示警示。
输入 4763 被范围验证拒绝，当前 F3368 不变；重新输入 0，再点下个内容变化到 F9 / PTS 4800 / 时长 544。
仅原片模式显示源图面板、隐藏叠加面板；切回叠加模式正常。
从 F840 切到 F4182 后重试图片并换底色，最终仍显示 F4182 及正确的 bf18b6… FX 资源。
最终样本均显示 PNG 已读取。此前素材生成期间缺图会明确报错，没有用近邻帧冒充；没有故意破坏最终素材来注入故障。

automated_viewer_contract_tests.scope: Fixture/renderer contracts include missing-source fallback, safe path handling and generation-token race protection; not all fault cases injected into live final assets.

preview_playback.audio_evidence: Independent encoding verification preserves all 7453 AAC packets and their timestamps. The observed ended state includes the audio tail.

limitations: Live UI checks cover the listed flows and sample frames, not every combination of 4763 frames or every browser.
Earlier simultaneous build writes coincided with preview resets; final flows were repeated against frozen HTML. The cause was not asserted as an application defect.
Browser-extension metadata errors were visible in the console; no application JavaScript failure was observed in the listed final flows.
Screenshots were inspected through CUA; reproducible visual contact-sheet evidence is delivered separately.
UI rendering and playback do not certify complete glyphs, flawless effect mattes, or original author alpha.
